key.name: last-module
key.description: The module name restored when gsword starts.

key.name: last-key
key.description: The key text restored when gsword starts.

key.name: font-scale
key.description: Multiplier applied to the reader font size.

key.name: theme
key.description: One of system, light, or dark.

key.name: sidebar-visible
key.description: Whether the module sidebar is shown in wide window layouts.

key.name: active-page
key.description: One of reader, panes, search, notes, plan, teaching, or library. Legacy parallel is migrated to a panes template.

key.name: workspace-layout
key.description: Serialized list of comparison panes and their follow mode (0 follow, 1 pinned, 2 free).

key.name: workspace-columns
key.description: Number of columns used by the comparison workspace grid.

key.name: workspace-highlight-diffs
key.summary: Highlight textual differences between comparison panes

key.name: workspace-sync-scroll
key.description: Whether scrolling one comparison pane scrolls the other panes.

key.name: parallel-a
key.description: Legacy first module used to initialize the parallel pane template.

key.name: parallel-b
key.description: Legacy second module used to initialize the parallel pane template.

key.name: active-plan-id
key.description: Identifier of the reading plan shown in the Plan workspace.

key.name: study-visible
key.description: Whether the study panel is shown in the reading workspace.

key.name: study-follow
key.summary: Study panel follows the active verse
key.description: Whether study resources follow the active Bible verse or stay pinned.

key.name: study-pinned-key
key.description: The reference retained when the study panel is not following the active verse.

key.name: study-module
key.description: Commentary module shown in the study panel.

key.name: study-lexicon
key.description: Lexicon module shown in the study panel.

key.name: devotion-module
key.description: Module used by the Daily Devotion tab.

key.name: reader-history
key.description: Serialized recent reading entries: module, OSIS reference, display text, and timestamp.

key.name: reader-history-index
key.description: Index of the current entry in reader-history.

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: HTTP proxy used for module downloads, empty to use the environment default.

key.name: proxy-user
key.description: Optional user name for the HTTP proxy.

key.name: proxy-password
key.description: Optional password for the HTTP proxy.
